== ConLeche/IsModel.lean#L160-L168
   160  def Declaration.constants : Declaration → List ConstantInfo
   161    | .axiomDecl cv =>
   162      if cv.name = quotSoundName then [quotAt .sound cv]
   163      else if cv.name = sorryAxName then []
   164      else [.axiomInfo cv]
   165    | .defnDecl cv v hint => if usesSorry v then [.axiomInfo cv] else [.defnInfo cv v hint]

   167    | .opaqueDecl cv _ => [.axiomInfo cv]
   168    | .quotDecl k cv => [quotAt k cv]

    84  @[expose] def Declaration.Declares : Declaration → ConstantVal → Prop

== ConLeche/Kernel/Core.lean#L1866-L1884
  1866  def defeqBody (eager : Bool) (r : CoreFns m) (env : Env) : Nat → Expr → Expr → m Bool :=
  1867    fun depth a b => do
  1868      if a == b then pure true else
  1869      match ctorTargetFor env eager a b with
  1870      | some c =>
  1871        let w ← r.whnf depth a
  1872        match ctorHeadAgainst env c w with
  1873        | some true => defeqLazy mode eager r env depth w b
  1874        | some false => pure false
  1875        | none => defeqLazy mode eager r env depth a b
  1876      | none =>
  1877      match ctorTargetFor env eager b a with
  1878      | some c =>
  1879        let w ← r.whnf depth b
  1880        match ctorHeadAgainst env c w with
  1881        | some true => defeqLazy mode eager r env depth a w
  1882        | some false => pure false
  1883        | none => defeqLazy mode eager r env depth a b
  1884      | none => defeqLazy mode eager r env depth a b

== ConLeche/Term/Syntax.lean#L188-L219
   188  inductive Term where
   189    /-- de Bruijn index -/
   190    | bvar (i : Nat)
   191    /-- `Sort u` at a concrete level -/
   192    | sort (u : Nat)
   193    /-- a built-in constant at a concrete level instantiation -/
   194    | const (c : BConst) (us : List Nat)
   195    /-- application -/
   196    | app (f a : Term)
   197    /-- `fun (_ : ty) => body` -/
   198    | lam (ty body : Term)
   199    /-- `(_ : ty) → body` -/
   200    | pi (ty body : Term)
   201    /-- `let _ := val; body`, **without the type**: the body is under one
   202    binder, read at the value -/
   203    | letE (val body : Term)
   204    /-- `@Eq _ lhs rhs`, **without the type**: the interpretation is
   205    `⟦eqE a b⟧ = eqv ⟦a⟧ ⟦b⟧`, so soundness never constrains the type,
   206    and no definition and no theorem in any tier reads the type, so
   207    the constructor does not carry it; a producer that knows the type
   208    simply drops it. -/
   209    | eqE (lhs rhs : Term)
   210    /-- First field of a pair.  Carries **only** the subject: the pair's
   211    type arguments come from the typing premise `Γ ⊢ p : Σ A B`,
   212    not from the term — see the module docstring.  Interpreted by
   213    `sfst`, i.e. literally `interp`'s clause. -/
   214    | fst (e : Term)
   215    /-- Second field of a pair; the `fst` twin, interpreted by `ssnd`. -/
   216    | snd (e : Term)
   217    /-- the canonical (irrelevant) proof of a derivable equation -/
   218    | prf
   219    deriving Repr, Inhabited

== ConLeche/Semantics/Interp.lean#L134-L145
   134  noncomputable def interp : (Nat → V) → Term → V
   135    | ρ, .bvar i => ρ i
   136    | _, .sort u => univ u
   137    | _, .const c us => bval V c us
   138    | ρ, .app f a => SetTheory.app (interp ρ f) (interp ρ a)
   139    | ρ, .lam A b => lamV (interp ρ A) fun x => interp (cons x ρ) b
   140    | ρ, .pi A B => piV (interp ρ A) fun x => interp (cons x ρ) B
   141    | ρ, .letE v b => interp (cons (interp ρ v) ρ) b
   142    | ρ, .eqE a b => eqv (interp ρ a) (interp ρ b)
   143    | ρ, .fst e => sfst (interp ρ e)
   144    | ρ, .snd e => ssnd (interp ρ e)
   145    | _, .prf => pt

== ConLeche/Model/Denotes.lean#L194-L200
   194  theorem Denotes_of_denote {acval : Name → (Name → Nat) → Term}
   195      (hcl : ∀ n ψ, Term.Closed (acval n ψ)) {env : Env} {φ : Name → Nat} :
   196      ∀ (d : Nat) (e : Expr) {ta : Term},
   197        denote acval env φ d e = some ta →
   198        Expr.fvarsBelow d e → e.looseBVarsBounded 0 = true →
   199        ∀ ρ : Nat → V,
   200          Denotes (cvalOf (V := V) acval) env φ ρ (closeN d e) (interp V ρ ta) := by

== ConLeche/Semantics/WellDenoted.lean#L49-L72
    49  def WellDenoted : (Nat → V) → Term → Prop
    50    | ρ, .pi A B =>
    51      WellDenoted ρ A ∧ IsTy (interp V ρ A) ∧
    52      (∀ x, x ∈ˢ interp V ρ A → WellDenoted (cons x ρ) B) ∧
    53      (∀ x, x ∈ˢ interp V ρ A → IsTy (interp V (cons x ρ) B))
    54    | ρ, .lam A b =>
    55      WellDenoted ρ A ∧ IsTy (interp V ρ A) ∧
    56      (∀ x, x ∈ˢ interp V ρ A → WellDenoted (cons x ρ) b)
    57    | ρ, .app f a =>
    58      WellDenoted ρ f ∧ WellDenoted ρ a ∧ AppliesTo (interp V ρ f) (interp V ρ a)
    59    | ρ, .fst e =>
    60      WellDenoted ρ e ∧
    61      ∃ u v A Bf, interp V ρ e ∈ˢ sigmaSet (Nat.max u v) A Bf ∧
    62        A ∈ˢ univ u ∧ ∀ x, x ∈ˢ A → Bf x ∈ˢ univ v
    63    | ρ, .snd e =>
    64      WellDenoted ρ e ∧
    65      ∃ u v A Bf, interp V ρ e ∈ˢ sigmaSet (Nat.max u v) A Bf ∧
    66        A ∈ˢ univ u ∧ ∀ x, x ∈ˢ A → Bf x ∈ˢ univ v
    67    | ρ, .eqE a b => WellDenoted ρ a ∧ WellDenoted ρ b
    68    | ρ, .letE v b => WellDenoted ρ v ∧ WellDenoted (cons (interp V ρ v) ρ) b
    69    | _, .bvar _ => True
    70    | _, .sort _ => True
    71    | _, .const _ _ => True
    72    | _, .prf => True

== ConLeche/Model/Env/EnvModel.lean#L35-L63
    35  structure EnvModel (env : Env) where
    36    /-- the shared, model-free environment well-formedness -/
    37    wf : EnvWF env
    38    /-- the leaf valuation: each constant's reading at a level assignment -/
    39    acval : Name → (Name → Nat) → Term
    40    /-- every leaf is closed -/
    41    cval_closed : ∀ (n : Name) (ψ : Name → Nat),
    42      Term.Closed (acval n ψ)
    43    /-- the reserved basis constants are the pinned declarations, valued
    44    by their direct pins (V-free) -/
    45    basis_pinned : BasisPinnedTT env acval
    46    /-- every stored native projection-table entry is a pinned pair
    47    entry with its block stored (V-free, shared) -/
    48    proj_ok : ProjOkT env
    49    /-- every stored recursor rule's constructor is stored (V-free,
    50    shared) -/
    51    rec_ctors : RecCtorsStored env
    52    /-- a leaf reads only its own level parameters -/
    53    acval_params : ∀ (n : Name) (ci : ConstantInfo),
    54      env.find? n = some ci →
    55      ∀ ψ₁ ψ₂ : Name → Nat,
    56        (∀ p ∈ ci.toConstantVal.levelParams, ψ₁ p = ψ₂ p) →
    57        acval n ψ₁ = acval n ψ₂
    58    /-- every leaf is truthful -/
    59    acval_wellDenoted : ∀ (n : Name) (ψ : Name → Nat) (ρ : Nat → V),
    60      WellDenoted V ρ (acval n ψ)
    61  
    62  variable {V}
    63  

== ConLeche/Model/Claims.lean#L49-L125
    49  /-- Head normalisation, dual success, P currency, conditional on the
    50  point (task #342, L9): the reduct is graded and equal where the subject
    51  is not the point. -/
    52  @[expose] def WhnfCoreClaim {env : Env} (m : EnvModel V env)
    53      (φ : Name → Nat) (fuel : Nat) : Prop :=
    54    ∀ {d : Nat} {e e' : Expr} {Δa : List Term},
    55      whnfCore .verified false env fuel d e = .ok e' →
    56      Expr.WScoped d e → e.looseBVarsBounded 0 = true →
    57      Expr.LeavesBounded e →
    58      ∀ {ea ea' : Term},
    59        CtxOk m φ d Δa e →
    60        denote m.acval env φ d e = some ea →
    61        denote m.acval env φ d e' = some ea' →
    62        (∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat V Δa ρ → WellDenoted V ρ ea) →
    63        (∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat V Δa ρ → interp V ρ ea ≠ pt →
    64            WellDenoted V ρ ea') ∧
    65          ∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat V Δa ρ → interp V ρ ea ≠ pt →
    66            interp V ρ ea = interp V ρ ea'
    67  
    68  /-- The reduction loop, dual success, P currency, conditional on the
    69  point (task #342, L9). -/
    70  @[expose] def WhnfClaim {env : Env} (m : EnvModel V env)
    71      (φ : Name → Nat) (fuel : Nat) : Prop :=
    72    ∀ {d : Nat} {e e' : Expr} {Δa : List Term},
    73      whnf .verified false env fuel d e = .ok e' →
    74      Expr.WScoped d e → e.looseBVarsBounded 0 = true →
    75      Expr.LeavesBounded e →
    76      ∀ {ea ea' : Term},
    77        CtxOk m φ d Δa e →
    78        denote m.acval env φ d e = some ea →
    79        denote m.acval env φ d e' = some ea' →
    80        (∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat V Δa ρ → WellDenoted V ρ ea) →
    81        (∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat V Δa ρ → interp V ρ ea ≠ pt →
    82            WellDenoted V ρ ea') ∧
    83          ∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat V Δa ρ → interp V ρ ea ≠ pt →
    84            interp V ρ ea = interp V ρ ea'
    85  
    86  /-- Definitional equality, P currency, conditional on the point (task
    87  #342, L9): two sides that are not the point are equal.  A consumer
    88  comparing two types or two members of one type closes with
    89  `eq_of_IsTy_of_ne_pt` / `IsTy.eq_of_ne_pt`. -/
    90  @[expose] def DefEqClaim {env : Env} (m : EnvModel V env)
    91      (φ : Name → Nat) (fuel : Nat) : Prop :=
    92    ∀ {d : Nat} {a b : Expr} {Δa : List Term},
    93      ConLeche.isDefEqCore .verified false env fuel d a b = .ok true →
    94      Expr.WScoped d a → a.looseBVarsBounded 0 = true →
    95      Expr.LeavesBounded a →
    96      Expr.WScoped d b → b.looseBVarsBounded 0 = true →
    97      Expr.LeavesBounded b →
    98      ∀ {aa ba : Term},
    99        CtxOk m φ d Δa a →
   100        CtxOk m φ d Δa b →
   101        denote m.acval env φ d a = some aa →
   102        denote m.acval env φ d b = some ba →
   103        (∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat V Δa ρ → WellDenoted V ρ aa) →
   104        (∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat V Δa ρ → WellDenoted V ρ ba) →
   105        ∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat V Δa ρ →
   106          interp V ρ aa ≠ pt → interp V ρ ba ≠ pt →
   107          interp V ρ aa = interp V ρ ba
   108  
   109  /-- Inference, dual success, P currency: the subject's and the
   110  type's truthfulness are *conclusions*, and
   111  the type denotes a type. -/
   112  @[expose] def InferClaim {env : Env} (m : EnvModel V env)
   113      (φ : Name → Nat) (fuel : Nat) : Prop :=
   114    ∀ {d : Nat} {e t : Expr} {Δa : List Term},
   115      inferTypeCore .verified false env fuel d e = .ok t →
   116      Expr.WScoped d e → e.looseBVarsBounded 0 = true →
   117      Expr.LeavesBounded e →
   118      ∀ {ea ta : Term},
   119        CtxOk m φ d Δa e →
   120        denote m.acval env φ d e = some ea →
   121        denote m.acval env φ d t = some ta →
   122        (∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat V Δa ρ → WellDenoted V ρ ea) ∧
   123          (∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat V Δa ρ → WellDenotedTy V ρ ta) ∧
   124          ∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat V Δa ρ →
   125            interp V ρ ea ∈ˢ interp V ρ ta

== ConLeche/Model/Rules/IORel.lean#L53-L79
    53  
    54  /-- **The hereditary half**, by recursion on the type's syntax: at a
    55  ∀, a graph over its domain (a graded type) that is not everywhere the
    56  point, whose every application is the point, a member of, or
    57  hereditarily in the ∀'s body opened at the domain.  Nothing at any
    58  other type. -/
    59  @[expose] def IOHered (m : EnvModel V env) (φ : Name → Nat) :
    60      Nat → Expr → (Nat → V) → V → Prop
    61    | d, .forallE ty body, ρ, v =>
    62      ∃ tya, denote m.acval env φ d ty = some tya ∧ WellDenotedTy V ρ tya ∧
    63        (∃ F : V → V, v = graph F (interp V ρ tya)) ∧
    64        (∃ x, x ∈ˢ interp V ρ tya ∧ SetTheory.app v x ≠ pt) ∧
    65        ∀ x, x ∈ˢ interp V ρ tya →
    66          SetTheory.app v x = pt ∨
    67            IOMem m φ (d + 1) (body.instantiate1 (.fvar d ty)) (cons x ρ)
    68              (SetTheory.app v x) ∨
    69            IOHered m φ (d + 1) (body.instantiate1 (.fvar d ty)) (cons x ρ)
    70              (SetTheory.app v x)
    71    | _, _, _, _ => False
    72  termination_by _ e => e.sizeB
    73  decreasing_by
    74    rw [ConLeche.Expr.sizeB_instantiate1 _ rfl]; simp [ConLeche.Expr.sizeB]; omega
    75  
    76  /-- **The io claim**: the point, a member, or hereditarily a member. -/
    77  @[expose] def IORel (m : EnvModel V env) (φ : Name → Nat) (d : Nat) (T : Expr)
    78      (ρ : Nat → V) (v : V) : Prop :=
    79    v = pt ∨ IOMem m φ d T ρ v ∨ IOHered m φ d T ρ v

== ConLeche/Rules/Rel.lean#L18-L45
    18    rule, literal acceleration, δ, the two literal expansions, and the
    19    congruences the bodies recurse through (`appFn`, `projArg`).  `refl`
    20    and `trans` are constructors: a reduction is a denotation identity,
    21    so chaining costs nothing semantically, and the checker's loops and
    22    the major's preparation are chains.
    23  * `DefEq env d a b` — definitional equality.  **No `trans`** (ruling 1):
    24    every non-leaf rule carries a further `DefEq` premise modelling the
    25    recursive structure of `isDefEq` — `redL` is "reduce the left side,
    26    then the continuation is definitionally equal", and with `Red` holding
    27    δ and the literal steps it is every continuation of the lazy-delta
    28    loop at once.  `symm` is a constructor; the right-hand variants of
    29    the one-sided rules are derived (`ConLeche/Rules/Derived.lean`).
    30  * `DefEqLams env d a b` — λ-congruence of two λ-telescopes (task #349):
    31    domains at every level, the opened bodies' FULL-grade types compared
    32    at the innermost level only (`inner`/`outer`).
    33  * `DefEqExpand env d a b T` — two sides of one type compared after
    34    their η-expansion along the type's binders (task #515).
    35  * `UnitLike env d T`, `UnitFields env d tele n` — official's
    36    `is_unit_like` (task #515): a ∀ with a unit-like codomain, or an η
    37    family whose fields (possibly none) are propositions or unit-like.
    38  * `Infer env g d e t` — type inference at a grade `g` (`Grade.full` for
    39    the front door, `Grade.io` for the infer-only lane).  The grade
    40    propagates to the recursive premises as `CoreFns.ioView` does.  The
    41    io grade is Lean's `infer_only` (task #346; the fragment's `InferIO`,
    42    `whitepaper/Fragment/IOGrade.lean`): the application rule runs no
    43    argument certificate, the λ rule no domain-sort check, the `let` rule
    44    no check of the value (the `g = .full →` premises).  Its claim is the
    45    hereditary `IORel`, keyed on the type's syntax, not membership.

== ConLeche/Kernel/CoreDefs.lean#L611-L638
   611  /-- Stored-constant guards for op `c`: the `Nat` basis, every
   612  dependency stored, and (for the `Bool`-valued ops and
   613  the `ble`-guarded `div`/`mod`, whose semantic clauses mention the
   614  `Bool` constructor values) the `Bool` constructors stored, level-free,
   615  at the type `Bool` itself (their values must be members of `Bool`'s,
   616  so that a recurrence `beq 0 0 = true` relates two members of one
   617  type).
   618  
   619  A dependency is only required to be stored: what kind of constant it
   620  is, its level parameters and its type are its own job's business.  At
   621  a certified operation's name nothing but a definition is accepted, and
   622  a definition there runs the operation's own install check, which pins
   623  its type (`natOpStoredOk`) and certifies its recurrences.  Storedness
   624  is what that leaves: an absent dependency would let a certificate pass
   625  over a name with nothing behind it. -/
   626  def natOpGuard (env : Env) (c : Name) : Bool :=
   627    natLitSupported env &&
   628    (natOpDeps c).all (fun n => (env.find? n).isSome) &&
   629    (if c = natBeqName || c = natBleName || natDivModNames.contains c then
   630      (match env.find? boolTrueName with
   631        | some ci => ci.toConstantVal.levelParams.isEmpty &&
   632            ci.toConstantVal.type == .const boolName []
   633        | none => false) &&
   634      (match env.find? boolFalseName with
   635        | some ci => ci.toConstantVal.levelParams.isEmpty &&
   636            ci.toConstantVal.type == .const boolName []
   637        | none => false)
   638     else true)

== ConLeche/Cached/StateC.lean#L227-L240
   227  compute.  `a ^ b` has at most `natSizeBytes a * b` bytes, and a base
   228  `≤ 1` gives `0` or `1`; `a <<< b` has about `natSizeBytes a + b / 8`
   229  bytes, and `0 <<< b = 0`. -/
   230  def natOpRefusal (maxNatSize : Nat) (op : NatBinOp) (a b : Nat) : Option CheckError :=
   231    match op with
   232    | .pow =>
   233      if b > natCountMax then some (natCountTooBig "Nat.pow")
   234      else if a > 1 && b != 0 && natSizeBytes a > maxNatSize / b then
   235        some (.invalid "the kernel refused to evaluate `Nat.pow` because the result would \
   236          exceed the maximum numeral size; raise it with --max-nat-size")
   237      else none
   238    | .shiftLeft =>
   239      if a = 0 then none
   240      else if b > natCountMax then some (natCountTooBig "Nat.shiftLeft")

== ConLeche/SetTheory/Core.lean#L95-L133
    95  /-- A model of set theory of exactly the strength the checker needs:
    96  membership, the six ZF⁻ axioms (extensionality, pairing, union, power
    97  set, regularity, Lean-level replacement), and an ω-chain of
    98  Grothendieck universes.  Infinity is derivable; choice is inherited
    99  from the meta-logic (`Classical.choice`); see the module docstring. -/
   100  class SetTheory (V : Type u) where
   101    /-- Set membership. -/
   102    Mem : V → V → Prop
   103    /-- Extensionality: sets with the same members are equal. -/
   104    ext : ∀ {x y : V}, (∀ z, Mem z x ↔ Mem z y) → x = y
   105    /-- Pairing: the unordered pair. -/
   106    upair : V → V → V
   107    /-- Characterization of the unordered pair. -/
   108    mem_upair : ∀ {z a b : V}, Mem z (upair a b) ↔ z = a ∨ z = b
   109    /-- Union: the union of the members. -/
   110    sUnion : V → V
   111    /-- Characterization of the union. -/
   112    mem_sUnion : ∀ {z x : V}, Mem z (sUnion x) ↔ ∃ y, Mem y x ∧ Mem z y
   113    /-- Power set. -/
   114    power : V → V
   115    /-- Characterization of the power set: members are the subsets. -/
   116    mem_power : ∀ {z x : V}, Mem z (power x) ↔ ∀ w, Mem w z → Mem w x
   117    /-- Regularity: every nonempty set has an `∈`-minimal member. -/
   118    regularity : ∀ x : V, (∃ y, Mem y x) → ∃ y, Mem y x ∧ ¬ ∃ z, Mem z y ∧ Mem z x
   119    /-- Replacement, as a Lean-level scheme: the image of a set under an
   120    arbitrary function `V → V`. -/
   121    image : (V → V) → V → V
   122    /-- Characterization of the replacement image. -/
   123    mem_image : ∀ {f : V → V} {a z : V}, Mem z (image f a) ↔ ∃ w, Mem w a ∧ z = f w
   124    /-- An ω-chain of Grothendieck universes: the sets interpreting the
   125    universe tower (Carneiro's ω-many inaccessibles, op. cit.;
   126    intended model `V_{κ n}`). -/
   127    univChain : Nat → V
   128    /-- The chain increases strictly: each universe is a member of the
   129    next. -/
   130    univChain_mem : ∀ n : Nat, Mem (univChain n) (univChain (n + 1))
   131    /-- Each chain member is a Grothendieck universe (Tarski's Axiom A
   132    matrix with transitivity, `IsTGUniverse`). -/
   133    univChain_tg : ∀ n : Nat, IsTGUniverse Mem (univChain n)

== ConLeche/SetTheory/Core.lean#L89-L93
    89  def IsTGUniverse {V : Type u} (mem : V → V → Prop) (u : V) : Prop :=
    90    (∀ y z, mem y u → mem z y → mem z u) ∧
    91    (∀ y z, mem y u → (∀ w, mem w z → mem w y) → mem z u) ∧
    92    (∀ y, mem y u → ∃ p, mem p u ∧ ∀ z, (∀ w, mem w z → mem w y) → mem z p) ∧
    93    (∀ y, (∀ w, mem w y → mem w u) → Equinumerous mem y u ∨ mem y u)

   200  theorem carneiro_implies_conleche :
   201      OmegaInaccessibles.{u} → Nonempty (Σ V : Type (u + 1), ConLeche.SetTheory V) :=
   202    fun h => ⟨⟨ZFSet.{u}, setTheoryOfCarneiro h⟩⟩

   185  def stdAxiomOk (env : Env) (cv : ConstantVal) : Bool :=
   186    if cv.name = propextName then
   187      (env.find? eqName).isSome &&
   188      (match env.find? iffName with

   190       | _ => false) &&

   192       | some (.ctorInfo cvIi 2 2 _) =>

   194       | _ => false) &&
   195      (match env.find? iffRecName with
   196       | some (.recInfo cvIr 4 4 _ _) =>
   197         ConstantVal.matchesPin cvIr iffRecA.toConstantVal
   198       | _ => false) &&
   199      ConstantVal.matchesPin cv propextA
   200    else if cv.name = choiceName then
   201      (match env.find? nonemptyName with
   202       | some (.indInfo cvN _) =>
   203         ConstantVal.matchesPin cvN nonemptyA.toConstantVal
   204       | _ => false) &&
   205      (match env.find? nonemptyIntroName with
   206       | some (.ctorInfo cvNi 1 1 _) =>
   207         ConstantVal.matchesPin cvNi nonemptyIntroA.toConstantVal
   208       | _ => false) &&
   209      (match env.find? nonemptyRecName with
   210       | some (.recInfo cvNr 3 3 _ _) =>
   211         ConstantVal.matchesPin cvNr nonemptyRecA.toConstantVal
   212       | _ => false) &&
   213      ConstantVal.matchesPin cv choiceA
   214    else false

== ConLeche/Kernel/TrustAxioms.lean#L9-L38
     9  /-!
    10  # The compiler-trust axiom family (task #95)
    11  
    12  `Init`'s compiler-trust scaffolding is installed rather than
    13  declined:
    14  
    15  * `Lean.trustCompiler : True` is trivially realizable — it is
    16    installed as an *opaque* (stored `axiomInfo`, exactly like a checked
    17    `opaque` declaration) with value `True.intro`, over a pinned `True`
    18    family.  No new meta-axiom: the model is `True.intro`'s own
    19    interpretation.
    20  * `Lean.reduceNat` / `Lean.reduceBool` then check as ordinary
    21    `opaque`s (their exported values are identity functions modulo the
    22    `have := trustCompiler` wrapper); at its check their stored values are
    23    pinned against the identity function
    24    (`ConLeche/Kernel/TrustPins.lean`, hand-pinned since task #273 —
    25    every toolchain's definition after zeta) by definitional equality —
    26    the task-#47 pattern: drift declines, never silently.
    27  * `Lean.ofReduceNat` / `Lean.ofReduceBool` are pinned axioms over
    28    those stored opaques (the task-#34 standard-axioms machinery).  With
    29    the stored reduce operation certified to be the identity (a
    30    definitional-equality certificate at the operation's own install,
    31    `checkReducePin`; the axiom's install checks `ofReduceAxOk`),
    32    `∀ a b, reduceNat a = b → a = b` interprets to
    33    an inhabited proposition (the hypothesis *is* the conclusion), so
    34    both axioms are true in the set model with the proof point as value.
    35  
    36  `sorryAx` remains the only axiom tolerated as a *declaration*: its
    37  record installs nothing and any use of it declines
    38  (`sorryAxName`, `ConLeche/Kernel/Basis/Names.lean`).

== ConLeche/Kernel/Env.lean#L193-L228
   193  structure IndCaps where
   194    /-- Official's `is_non_rec_structure`: one constructor, no index, a block that
   195    is not recursive.  A proposition may have it: a proof is the point, and the
   196    η laws speak of what is not. -/
   197    eta : Bool := false
   198    /-- **The block's members** (official's `all`): the formers installed
   199    together with this one, in block
   200    order, itself included.  Read by nested positivity alone — a container
   201    frame's restart (`nestFrame`) abstracts only group-mates listed here,
   202    so an accepted frame's holes are members of ONE recorded block (a pinned
   203    basis type records `[T]`, as official does; `Quot` alone keeps `[]`). -/
   204    all : List Name := []
   205    /-- **The family's parameter count** (official's `inductive_val.nparams`):
   206    the block's declared parameter count, recorded at every install
   207    (uniform: `BlockShape.nP`; basis: the pin's).  Read by nested positivity
   208    alone, and only for a
   209    container WITHOUT constructors (`nestContainer`), whose parameter count
   210    no constructor record carries. -/
   211    nparams : Nat := 0
   212    /-- **The family's index count** (official's `inductive_val.nindices`), read
   213    off the block's recursor record: how many binders past the parameters the
   214    reading of the family's sort walks (`formerSortLoop`). -/
   215    nIdx : Nat := 0
   216    /-- **The family's constructors, in declaration order** (official's
   217    `inductive_val.cnstrs`): recorded at its check (uniform: the member's
   218    constructors; basis: the pin's).  Read by nested positivity alone
   219    (`nestContainer`): a container's constructors are looked up by name,
   220    never by a scan of the environment.  `Quot` records none (it is no
   221    container). -/
   222    ctors : List Name := []
   223    /-- **The family's sort is never zero** (official's `is_never_zero` at
   224    every level instantiation): the former's stored type ends in a sort
   225    whose zero-ness datum is unsatisfiable (`formerZ`), read off it at its
   226    check (`blockCapsAt`).  `false` claims nothing.  The ι step's case split
   227    reads it in place of the walk to the family's sort. -/
   228    neverZero : Bool := false

== ConLeche/Kernel/Env.lean#L291-L313
   291  inductive ConstantInfo where
   292    | axiomInfo (val : ConstantVal)
   293    | defnInfo (val : ConstantVal) (value : Expr) (hint : ReducibilityHint)
   294    | thmInfo (val : ConstantVal)
   295    /-- An inductive type former (whnf-stuck) with its capabilities. -/
   296    | indInfo (val : ConstantVal) (caps : IndCaps)
   297    /-- A constructor (whnf-stuck; the iota target), with its family's name
   298    (official's `ConstructorVal.induct`): the head constant of its declared
   299    type's result, which its install reads off the member it is checked
   300    against (an environment invariant, `CtorWF`).  The readers that need the
   301    family (the ι case split, the rescues, η) look it up by this name instead
   302    of walking the type. -/
   303    | ctorInfo (val : ConstantVal) (numParams numFields : Nat) (induct : Name)
   304    /-- A recursor with its iota rules and the record's K flag (official's
   305    `recursor_val::is_k`, read off the stream's record; the block's job
   306    checks it).  Only the two sums the
   307    firing path reads are stored: `majorIdx` (= numParams + numMotives +
   308    numMinors + numIndices, the major premise's argument position) and
   309    `rulePrefix` (= numParams + numMotives + numMinors, the length of the
   310    argument prefix a rule's rhs is applied to).  The individual counts
   311    are consumed at its check only and are not stored. -/
   312    | recInfo (val : ConstantVal) (majorIdx rulePrefix : Nat)
   313        (isK : Bool) (rules : List RecRule)

== ConLeche/Kernel/Install.lean#L38-L50
    38  the index binders to the rule prefix. -/
    39  def recFire (p : BlockShape) (rc : RecShape) : RecRuleFire :=
    40    if rc.tgt < p.k then .plain
    41    else
    42      match rc.cvR.type.stripPis rc.mI with
    43      | some (_, .forallE dom _) =>
    44        match dom.getAppFn with
    45        | .const _ us =>
    46          let nI := rc.mI - rc.rP
    47          let args := dom.getAppArgs
    48          .nested us ((args.take (args.length - nI)).map (Expr.dropVars nI))
    49        | _ => .plain
    50      | _ => .plain

== ConLeche/Kernel/Env.lean#L255-L266
   255  structure ProjTable where
   256    structName : Name
   257    /-- the parent type former's level parameters -/
   258    levelParams : List Name
   259    /-- the parent's parameter count -/
   260    numParams : Nat
   261    /-- the single constructor (the structural rule's head) -/
   262    ctor : Name
   263    /-- its field count -/
   264    numFields : Nat
   265    /-- per field, the projection's result-type body (see above) -/
   266    bodies : Array Expr

== ConLeche/Kernel/Install.lean#L60-L69
    60  its constructor's type (`structProjBodies`).  `none` where a structure-like member's constructor
    61  type is too short to read them: a block whose constructors pass their checks always has its
    62  tables (`checkBlock` rejects the other case). -/
    63  def blockTables (p : BlockShape) : List MemberShape → Option (List ProjTable)
    64    | [] => some []
    65    | ms :: rest =>
    66      match ms.structCtor? with
    67      | some c =>
    68        (structProjBodies ms.declared.name p.nP c.2 c.1.type).bind fun bodies =>
    69          (blockTables p rest).map (⟨ms.declared.name, p.lps, p.nP, c.1.name, c.2, bodies⟩ :: ·)

== ConLeche/Kernel/Core.lean#L1205-L1215
  1205  def checkProjGuard (inf wh : Nat → Expr → m Expr) (env : Env) (entry : ProjEntry)
  1206      (us : List Level) : m Unit :=
  1207    match env.find? entry.structName with
  1208    | some (.indInfo cvT caps) => do
  1209      match ← projGuardSort wh cvT caps us with
  1210      | none => pure ()
  1211      | some guardSort =>
  1212        match projGuardRows env.find? entry us with
  1213        | some rows => checkGuardRows inf wh guardSort rows
  1214        | none => throw (.invalid "projection from a propositional structure must be a proposition")
  1215    | _ => throw (.invalid "projection from a propositional structure must be a proposition")

== ConLeche/Kernel/FEnv.lean#L193-L218
   193  structure FEnv where
   194    env : Env
   195    idx : Std.HashMap Name ConstantInfo
   196    /-- The frozen lookup layer under the index (`FBase`): consulted on an
   197    index miss.  Empty everywhere except in a view of a stream's index;
   198    `mkFEnv` and `push` leave it as it is. -/
   199    base : FBase
   200    /-- The **overlay**: constants consed onto `env` WITHOUT
   201    entering the index, newest first (`overlay`).  Empty on every
   202    environment a step threads (`mkFEnv`, `push`); non-empty only on
   203    the inductive block's rule-less-recursor environment, a read-only view
   204    that shares the constructors' index instead of copying it.  `find?`
   205    reads it before the index, as if its constants had been pushed
   206    (`find?_overlay_pushAll`, `ConLeche/Verify/Cached/BlockOverlay.lean`). -/
   207    ovl : List ConstantInfo
   208    /-- **The projection tables** (task #362), keyed on the structure's
   209    name: `env.tables` as a map (the newest table of a name wins, as
   210    `List.find?` takes the first). -/
   211    tbls : Std.HashMap Name ProjTable
   212    /-- **Are `Nat` literals expandable** here: the core reads it at every literal it meets, so it is
   213    computed where the index is built and kept by every push (task #579). -/
   214    natLit : Bool
   215    /-- **Are string literals expandable** here (as `natLit`). -/
   216    strLit : Bool
   217    natLit_eq : natLit = natLitStoredBy (findIn idx base ovl)
   218    strLit_eq : strLit = strLitStoredBy (findIn idx base ovl)

== ConLeche/Kernel/Install.lean#L78-L91
    78  installs nothing (its job rejects it), and `sorryAx` nothing (any use of it declines). -/
    79  def declConstants : Declaration → List ConstantInfo
    80    | .defnDecl cv value hint => [.defnInfo cv value hint]
    81    | .thmDecl cv _ => [.thmInfo cv]
    82    | .opaqueDecl cv _ => [.axiomInfo cv]
    83    | .axiomDecl cv =>
    84      if cv.name = quotSoundName then [quotAt .sound cv]
    85      else if cv.name = sorryAxName then []
    86      else [.axiomInfo cv]
    87    | .quotDecl k cv => [quotAt k cv]
    88    | .indDecl block nP =>
    89      match readBlock nP block with
    90      | .ok p => blockConstants p
    91      | .error _ => []

== ConLeche/SetTheory/Core.lean#L95-L133
    95  /-- A model of set theory of exactly the strength the checker needs:
    96  membership, the six ZF⁻ axioms (extensionality, pairing, union, power
    97  set, regularity, Lean-level replacement), and an ω-chain of
    98  Grothendieck universes.  Infinity is derivable; choice is inherited
    99  from the meta-logic (`Classical.choice`); see the module docstring. -/
   100  class SetTheory (V : Type u) where
   101    /-- Set membership. -/
   102    Mem : V → V → Prop
   103    /-- Extensionality: sets with the same members are equal. -/
   104    ext : ∀ {x y : V}, (∀ z, Mem z x ↔ Mem z y) → x = y
   105    /-- Pairing: the unordered pair. -/
   106    upair : V → V → V
   107    /-- Characterization of the unordered pair. -/
   108    mem_upair : ∀ {z a b : V}, Mem z (upair a b) ↔ z = a ∨ z = b
   109    /-- Union: the union of the members. -/
   110    sUnion : V → V
   111    /-- Characterization of the union. -/
   112    mem_sUnion : ∀ {z x : V}, Mem z (sUnion x) ↔ ∃ y, Mem y x ∧ Mem z y
   113    /-- Power set. -/
   114    power : V → V
   115    /-- Characterization of the power set: members are the subsets. -/
   116    mem_power : ∀ {z x : V}, Mem z (power x) ↔ ∀ w, Mem w z → Mem w x
   117    /-- Regularity: every nonempty set has an `∈`-minimal member. -/
   118    regularity : ∀ x : V, (∃ y, Mem y x) → ∃ y, Mem y x ∧ ¬ ∃ z, Mem z y ∧ Mem z x
   119    /-- Replacement, as a Lean-level scheme: the image of a set under an
   120    arbitrary function `V → V`. -/
   121    image : (V → V) → V → V
   122    /-- Characterization of the replacement image. -/
   123    mem_image : ∀ {f : V → V} {a z : V}, Mem z (image f a) ↔ ∃ w, Mem w a ∧ z = f w
   124    /-- An ω-chain of Grothendieck universes: the sets interpreting the
   125    universe tower (Carneiro's ω-many inaccessibles, op. cit.;
   126    intended model `V_{κ n}`). -/
   127    univChain : Nat → V
   128    /-- The chain increases strictly: each universe is a member of the
   129    next. -/
   130    univChain_mem : ∀ n : Nat, Mem (univChain n) (univChain (n + 1))
   131    /-- Each chain member is a Grothendieck universe (Tarski's Axiom A
   132    matrix with transitivity, `IsTGUniverse`). -/
   133    univChain_tg : ∀ n : Nat, IsTGUniverse Mem (univChain n)

== ConLeche/OleanInput.lean#L97-L98
    97  def Sees (sp : Roots) (fs : FS) (m n m' : Name) : Prop :=
    98    ∃ p c, Loads sp fs m m' p ∧ InModulePart sp fs m' p c ∧ c.name = n

== ConLeche/Frontend/Olean/Snapshot.lean#L52-L66
    52  inductive LoadsAt (sp : Roots) (fs : FS) (g : Bool) (imps0 : Array ImportRec) : Name → Bool → Prop
    53    | root {i : ImportRec} : i ∈ imps0 → LoadsAt sp fs g imps0 i.module (g || i.importAll)
    54    | step {a : Name} {all : Bool} {d : ModDecoded} {i : ImportRec} :
    55        LoadsAt sp fs g imps0 a all → ViewOf sp fs a d → i ∈ d.imports →
    56        (i.isExported || all) = true → LoadsAt sp fs g imps0 i.module (g || all && i.importAll)
    57  
    58  /-- **Module `m`'s header loads part `p` of `m'`**: the private part where some path loads it
    59  whole, else the exported part (`LoadsAt`, from `m`'s private view's header). -/
    60  def Loads (sp : Roots) (fs : FS) (m m' : Name) (p : OLeanLevel) : Prop :=
    61    ∃ d, ViewOf sp fs m d ∧
    62      match p with
    63      | .private => LoadsAt sp fs (!d.isModule) d.imports m' true
    64      | .exported => LoadsAt sp fs (!d.isModule) d.imports m' false ∧
    65          ¬ LoadsAt sp fs (!d.isModule) d.imports m' true
    66      | .server => False

== ConLeche/MainTheorem.lean#L88-L94
